evidence.reason: The finding describes the old code where json.loads/data['agentId']/atomic ran before the try/finally. At the pinned tip the parse is done with JSONDecoder().raw_decode inside a try/except (lines 51-55), and atomic() is now the first statement inside the try block (lines 56-59) whose finally (line 90) stops the owned agent. The comments at lines 48-50 and 57-58 explicitly record this cleanup guarantee. The defect is no longer present; commit 82e1bb01b54dd29c968f751a5c5b70cbcb844901 ('harden driver stops, timeout logs and agent cleanup') introduced the fix.
